brief.zh: 在 $Y\le X<2Y$ 等权平均 $L_2(X)$，交换为 $\sum_{m,d}\mathbf1_{p=md-2\ {\rm prime},\,p\equiv2(3)}\log p\,c(d)\,K_Y(p,d)$。其中 $l=\max(Y,\lfloor50p/51\rfloor+1)$，$u=\min(2Y,p,d^3)$，$K_Y=Y^{-1}\sum_{l\le X<u}1/X$。空区间取零，$Y\ge2$，$m,d\ge1$，只须 $Y<p<102Y/50$。$X<d^3$ 当且仅当 $D_X<d$。
brief.en: Intersect the three strict window inequalities with the dyadic block. Keep the end at d cubed excluded.
